note: Band assignment is identical for every one of the 14,139 test rows across both prevalence settings -- only the corrected cut-point VALUES shown to the clinician change, never which band a given patient falls in. This is a direct consequence of the Bayes prior-shift correction being a monotonic bijection applied consistently to both the probability and the cut-points (same property already holds for the decision threshold; see before_after.json decisions_changed_by_prevalence_correction=0).
